justification: MARA canonical gross-profit growth uses compatible 2022 and 2021 annual GrossProfit facts; the legacy revenue-anchored selector omits the metric.
MARA canonical net-income growth uses compatible 2025 and 2024 annual NetIncomeLoss facts; the legacy revenue-anchored selector omits the metric.

MARA canonical consolidated net income reads the 2025 annual ProfitLoss fact on net income's own exact period; the legacy revenue-anchored selector finds no 2026 NetIncomeLoss fact, omits net income, and so withholds the consolidated figure.
MARA canonical gross margin uses exact-period compatible 2022 GrossProfit and revenue facts; the legacy selector omits rather than mixing periods.
MARA canonical net margin uses exact-period compatible 2025 NetIncomeLoss and revenue facts; the legacy selector omits rather than mixing periods.
MARA canonical ROA uses 2025 annual net income and the end-aligned 2025 total-assets fact in compatible USD units; the legacy selector omits the metric.
MARA canonical ROE uses 2025 annual net income and the end-aligned 2025 stockholders-equity fact in compatible USD units; the legacy selector omits the metric.
